subject: general
question: The length of a cuboid is half of its breadth and the height of cuboid is thrice of its breadth. If the breadth of the cuboid is 12 cm, then what is the total surface area of cuboid?
solution:
Given:

The length of a cuboid is half of its breadth and the height of the cuboid is thrice of its breadth.

The breadth of the cuboid is 12 cm.

Formula used:

The total surface area of a cuboid = 2 ×(lb× bh × lh)

(l = length, b = breadth , h = height)

Calculation: 

The height of the cuboid will be

⇒ 3 × 12 = 36 cm

The length of the cuboid will be

⇒ 12 /2 = 6 cm

the total surface area will be,

⇒ 2 ×(lb+ bh + lh)

⇒ 2 ×(36× 6 + 36 × 12 + 12 × 6)

⇒ 1440 cm2

∴ The correct option is 2
